digest.component_or_area: ticket close workflow / completion verification gate
propositions: A reader cannot distinguish a close with missing completion signature from a close with the gate off, because gate state is read and discarded at close time, collapsing multiple distinct close paths into a single observable state

completion_expectation must be persisted as a present-only enum on the *->closed STATUS event in the same locked write as the close, avoiding additional lock acquisition that would repeat the timeout failure being recorded

The completion_expectation enum must separately encode force_bypassed, gate_off, gate_unreadable, local_source, not_certifiable, disposition, required, and not_applicable to allow a later reader to reconstruct why a signature was or was not expected

Gate state must be resolved first so that a forced close under a disabled or unreadable config records the gate state (not force_bypassed), with the force reason remaining durable in force_close_reason
The idea->closed transition must record not_applicable directly in close_ticket without passing through _completion_precheck, since that path is guarded and never reaches the precheck
A historical close event lacking completion_expectation reduces to state with the key absent (unknown, never guessed), preserving backward compatibility
